subject: Private offer - FinCo strategic pilot: co-sell credit / discount request
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Grant <lisa.grant@finco.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private offer - FinCo strategic pilot: co-sell credit / discount request

Hi Lisa / team —

Great speaking yesterday. As discussed, FinCo wants to run a 6‑month strategic pilot across two business units; procurement has asked us to send a private AWS Marketplace offer with co-sell credits baked in so they can evaluate internal approvals.

Quick ask to Deal Desk (cc’d Rishi + Marketplace PMs): can we approve a one-time private-offer discount of 35% off list for the first 12 months + a 5% co-sell credit?

Why this matters:
- Expected first‑year ACV: ~$1.2M (annualized from pilot).
- Competitive situation: incumbent vendor is offering deep discounts to lock the account.
- Timeline: procurement wants a DocuSign-ready private offer by 20 Sep to align with their Q4 budget cycle.

Attachments: FinCo_LOI.pdf (signed LOI), pricing-model.xlsx (breakdown).

If Deal Desk needs additional comps, happy to drop a quick note with margin expectations and the signed LOI. We’re asking for expedited review given the procurement deadline.

Thanks,
Camila
Camila Reyes | Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

[attachment: pricing-model.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 12:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private offer - FinCo strategic pilot: co-sell credit / discount request

Camila —

Thanks for the context and the LOI. A few quick questions before I escalate for approval:
1) Can you confirm gross margin after the proposed 35% discount and the 5% co-sell credit? (we need line-item margin for finance).
2) Is this discount permanent on the SKU or limited to the private offer term?
3) Any legal/procurement constraints in the LOI we should be aware of (e.g., termination, data residency)?
4) Which exact SKU(s) should be published on the marketplace for the private offer?

If you can supply a one‑page justification (win rationale + 3 KPIs) and the margin calc, I can route to commercial approvals and marketplace product for the SKU gating. If procurement requires DocuSign, include the DocuSign link in your reply.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra | Deal Desk Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Lisa Grant <lisa.grant@finco.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private offer - FinCo strategic pilot: co-sell credit / discount request

Rishi — thanks. Answers below and attaching the margin calc. Quoting your questions inline for clarity.

> 1) Confirm gross margin after 35% discount + 5% credit?
We project ~42% gross margin in year 1 after marketplace fees and the co-sell credit. See attached pricing-model.xlsx tab "margin_calc".

> 2) Is discount permanent or limited?
This is limited to the private offer for the first 12 months (pilot). After that, list pricing resumes unless we mutually agree to extend.

> 3) Legal/procurement constraints?
Procurement wants a standard SOW + termination for convenience with 60 days' notice. No special data residency asks for the pilot.

> 4) SKU(s) to publish?
Publish SKU: SKU-RED-PRIME-2026 (we requested SKU reservation with MarketplaceOps; awaiting confirmation).

Attached: pricing-model.xlsx (margin_calc tab) and a signed LOI. Procurement has asked for DocuSign for the private offer; link: https://docusign.com/finco/rdw-offer (internal).

We need to close by 20 Sep — can Deal Desk and Marketplace confirm whether we can get a hard decision by 15 Sep to allow a day for legal + DocuSign?

Appreciate it,
Camila
[attachment: pricing-model.xlsx (xlsx)]
[attachment: FinCo_LOI.pdf (pdf)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, MarketplaceOps AWS <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 10:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private offer - FinCo strategic pilot: co-sell credit / discount request

Thanks for the details. A few marketplace items to flag before Deal Desk signs off: 

- Marketplace SKU gating: SKU-RED-PRIME-2026 requires manual review; per listing guidelines we can do a private offer but only if the SKU pricing delta vs public list is within allowed variance and the private offer is time-limited.
- Marketplace billing flow: co-sell credit mechanics must be specified in the offer metadata (we need the credit percentage and whether it applies to gross or net).
- Marketplace compliance: we need the SOW + certificate of insurance on file before publish.

Proposal from Marketplace team: approve a constrained exception — 20% discount for first 12 months + 5% co-sell credit (credit applied to net invoice). If Deal Desk and Finance can accept this compromise, we can publish the private offer within 48 hours of receiving the COI and signed SOW.

Attaching marketplace-checklist.pdf for the required artifacts. If you want a stricter exception (35% discount), this needs VP-level approval and a short risk memo. 

Laura
Laura Bennett | Marketplace PM, Redwood Inference
[attachment: marketplace-checklist.pdf (pdf)]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Lisa Grant <lisa.grant@finco.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private offer - FinCo strategic pilot: co-sell credit / discount request

Team —

Reviewed the thread and the margin calc. Given the strategic importance (high expansion potential, multi‑unit pilot) I approve a one-time exception with conditions: 

- Approved economics: up to 30% off list for the first 12 months + 5% co-sell credit applied to net invoice.
- Exception is one-time and must be tied to deal_id RDW-DEAL-2026-4517 in the private offer metadata.
- Requirements before publish: signed SOW, COI, and the DocuSign private-offer URL.
- Limitations: exception applies only to invoice items associated with SKU-RED-PRIME-2026, capped at the first $1.5M of billed revenue. Any extension beyond 12 months requires re-review and a postmortem capturing the ROI (metrics to be provided by Sales within 60 days of pilot end).

Camila: please provide the COI and SOW to Laura and Rishi so Marketplace can publish the private offer. Rishi — please route this to billing/finance to register the approved exception and confirm how the credit will be reconciled in our accounting system.

Thanks — Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni | VP, Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
